flushVolumes.title: Flushing volumes
flushVolumes.explain: How much the printer pushes out, in mm³, when it changes from the filament on the left to the one at the top. Worked out from the colours: dark to light needs more.
flushVolumes.suggested: Suggested: {{min}} to {{max}} mm³ (outside it shows red).
flushVolumes.towerOff: "Purge in prime tower" is off in this printer's settings (Multimaterial page), so each filament change purges the prime volume ({{volume}} mm³) instead of these amounts. They still set the flush length the printer's change G-code gets.
